Welcome to
Amboseli Serena Safari Lodge
Enjoy the view of Mount Kilimanjaro
Framed by acacia-dotted savannah and the towering presence of Mt Kilimanjaro, Amboseli Serena Safari Lodge is a haven for travellers seeking the soul of African adventure. Located in the heart of Amboseli National Park, our Mount Kilimanjaro view lodge blends Maasai-inspired design with warm hospitality and uninterrupted views of Africa's highest peak.
Set beside a gentle spring and surrounded by wildlife-rich plains, the lodge features a palm-shaded swimming pool, tranquil gardens, and a restaurant infused with local flavour. Every detail reflects the culture, spirit, and essence of Maasai heritage.
From sunrise views of Mt. Kilimanjaro's snow-capped summit to Big Five game drives and tree-planting through our Reforestation Programme, every moment here promises meaning and memory.
Answer the call of the wild at Amboseli Serena Safari Lodge, a destination rich in undiscovered experiences

Fact Sheet
Accommodation
Accommodation in Amboseli National Park
Immersed in the beauty of Amboseli National Park, our rooms offer an authentic stay in the heart of the wilderness. Each room is housed in a single-storey building that opens directly onto manicured grounds. Designed in the style of a traditional Maasai manyatta, the rooms feature hand-painted wildlife murals, locally inspired furnishings and vibrant colors inspired by Maasai heritage.
With amenities to rival the best safari lodges in Kenya, our 92 rooms and one suite include complimentary wireless internet, 24-hour room service and private balconies. For families and groups, we also offer nine sets of interconnecting rooms for added convenience.

Dining
A Taste of Amboseli – From Terrace to Bush
Every meal is a celebration of Kenyan culture and flavor. Enjoy locally inspired cuisine in our warm, Maasai-themed dining room or sip cocktails on the terrace as the firepit glows beneath the stars. For a truly unforgettable experience, dine under the night sky with a bush dinner set against the dramatic backdrop of Amboseli National Park.
Our menus showcase fresh, locally sourced produce, meats and dairy, offering an authentic taste of the region in every dish.
Children's Meals

Welcome to
Nairobi Serena Hotel
Best 5-Star Hotel in Nairobi
Tucked beside Central Park and surrounded by lush gardens, Nairobi Serena Hotel is a sanctuary of elegance and calm, just moments from the city's vibrant heart. Ideally located near the Central Business District and a short drive from Jomo Kenyatta International Airport, the hotel places you close to Nairobi's key diplomatic, corporate and cultural landmarks.
African heritage meets contemporary comfort. Influenced by design traditions from Ethiopia, the Maghreb, West Africa and East Africa, the hotel reflects quiet sophistication and warm hospitality in every detail.
With the Nairobi skyline shimmering just beyond your window, our spacious rooms and suites offer the perfect balance of comfort and refinement. The Maisha Spa & Health Club invites you to unwind through holistic wellness experiences.

Welcome to
Mara Serena Safari Lodge
A 5-Star Lodge In The Maasai Mara
Discover the safari of your dreams in Kenya's iconic Maasai Mara, where rolling plains are animated by migrating wildebeest. Perched high on a bush-covered hill, Mara Serena Safari Lodge is the only lodge in the Mara Triangle, with sweeping views of the savannah and Mara River.
Inspired by the circular design of a Maasai manyatta, the lodge blends traditional architecture with contemporary comfort. Each room offers privacy and panoramic views, some overlooking the river. Equally breathtaking sightlines can be enjoyed from the restaurant, bar, and rock-enclosed swimming pool.
After a day on safari, unwind with a steam shower or a signature Oringa Massage at the Maisha Spa & Gym. Dine on chef-crafted cuisine or experience a magical bush dinner under the stars.
Enjoy thrilling game drives, sundowners in the wild, visits to Maasai villages, or family breakfasts by the hippo pool. Whether you seek adventure or quiet escape the Lodge brings you closer to the spirit of the wild.
Read More
Read Less
Fact Sheet
Accommodation
Maasai Inspired Accommodation
The lodge features 74 rooms, including one suite, all influenced by Maasai heritage and local artistry. The breathtaking landscapes, uninterrupted views of the Mara River, and a design inspired by the traditional Maasai manyattas make Mara Serena Safari Lodge an unforgettable destination for safari holidays.
Each room is positioned to ensure uninterrupted views of the river and plains. Decorated in rich, swirling motifs that mirror the shapes and colours of the bush, rooms offer king-size or twin beds, mosquito net, and marble bathrooms with walk-in showers.
Modern comforts include complimentary Wi-Fi, TV in the Mara Suite, and ceiling fans, all designed to elevate your stay while keeping you connected to the wild.

Dining
A Maasai Dinner in The Bush
Dining in the Mara is more than a meal; it is an experience shaped by the flavors, culture and landscapes of the bush. Each dish is crafted using the finest local and seasonal ingredients, celebrating the richness of the region. Start your day with breakfast at sunrise by the hippo-filled Mara River, enjoy dinner under the stars or sip cocktails at sunset during a signature sundowner.
Each setting offers a unique perspective on the Mara's natural beauty.
Three times a week, dinners are accompanied by traditional Maasai dance performances, adding a vibrant cultural touch to your evening.

Enjoy a glass of chilled sparkling wine or fresh juice before settling at your table beneath the shade of acacia trees. A generous breakfast awaits, complete with fresh selections and a live cooking station where chefs prepare hot dishes to your preference.
